_purpose: Machine-readable path -> purpose index. Not exhaustive for content assets (PDFs, per-track JSON) - see docs/INVENTORY.md for aggregate counts. Update this file when a path's role changes, not on every content edit.

AGENTS.md.purpose: Single-entry orientation doc for AI sessions and new contributors

CLAUDE_CODE_STARTER_PROMPT.md.purpose: Predecessor to AGENTS.md, being folded in - check both until merged

index.html.purpose: Legacy content+engine source of truth (41K+ LOC) for tracks not yet migrated to content/

build.js.purpose: Extracts CSS/JS/per-track HTML from index.html; defines the baseNjk page-shell template string

course_schema.json.purpose: JSON Schema for content/{track}/*.json chapter/meta/practice-set files (target content system). blocks[] model (callout/table/cards/text/explorer kinds) — see docs/CONTENT_MODEL.md, docs/DECISIONS/0002 and 0003

app.py.purpose: Flask reverse-proxy for the AI chat feature - separate deployable, NOT built by GitHub Pages CI

sw.js.purpose: Service worker; precache list + SW_VERSION cache-bust string

sitemap.xml.purpose: Hand-maintained sitemap, one <url> per track + home

.eleventy.js.purpose: Eleventy config: input/output dirs, passthrough-copy list (must list every standalone root HTML page by hand)

package.json.purpose: npm scripts (build, start) and the 3 devDependencies

.github/workflows/deploy.yml.purpose: CI: npm run build -> deploy _site/ to gh-pages on push to main

changelog.html.purpose: Standalone page, own header/dark-mode toggle, not an Eleventy template

free-tier-promise.html.purpose: Standalone page, draft pending sign-off; describes pricing that is copy-only, not implemented

src/_includes/base.njk.purpose: Generated from build.js's baseNjk string for legacy tracks - do not hand-edit until WP3 (see docs/PHASE1-2_TARGET_ARCHITECTURE.md) retires this pattern

src/_includes/tracks/.purpose: Per-track HTML, generated by build.js from index.html - do not hand-edit, 21 files

src/_includes/partials/.purpose: NEW (target system): reusable chapter/quiz/explorer/video Nunjucks components, see docs/CONTENT_MODEL.md

src/{track}/index.njk.purpose: 21 thin (8-LOC) wrappers, one per track, set trackId and include the matching content

content/.purpose: Target content system: content/{track}/_meta.json (course meta + chapterOrder — the display-order source of truth), content/{track}/{chapter-slug}.json (one chapter each), content/{track}/_practice-set.json (optional) — all schema-validated against course_schema.json. qudrat, tahsili, act2, est2, est, appc, apstats, apbc, act, precalc, ibsl, and ibhl are fully migrated AND live (12/21) — see docs/DECISIONS/0005 through 0011, build.js's MIGRATED_TRACKS

src/_includes/partials/blocks/practice-p.purpose: Renders the 'practiceProblem' block kind (docs/DECISIONS/0006) — act2's in-chapter <div class="problem"> pattern, distinct from qud/tah's callout-warn practice problem and from the end-of-course practice-set's own shape

src/_includes/partials/blocks/worked-exa.purpose: Renders the 'workedExampleCard' block kind (docs/DECISIONS/0007) — appc's standalone <div class="fcard"> problem+solution pair, not part of a .formula-cards grid

src/_includes/partials/downloads-block.n.purpose: Renders a track's Downloads section from courseMeta.officialLinks[]/downloadsInfo — fixes a real unclosed-div bug present in the source across all 21 tracks

src/_includes/partials/practice-set.njk.purpose: Renders a track's numbered free-response practice list from content/{track}/_practice-set.json — distinct from bank-data/*.json's MCQ pools and from chapter blocks[] content

src/_includes/partials/chapter.njk.purpose: Renders one chapter from content/{track}/{chapter-slug}.json — dispatches each block to the matching partials/blocks/*.njk by kind

src/_includes/partials/_bilingual.njk.purpose: Shared macro: renders a {en,ar} field as dual .i18n-en/.i18n-ar spans, or as data-{attr}-en/-ar for attribute values — pairs with index.html's window.i18n toggle extension, see docs/DECISIONS/0004

src/_includes/partials/blocks/.purpose: callout.njk, table.njk, cards.njk, text.njk, explorer.njk — one partial per block kind in course_schema.json's blocks[] model. explorer.njk is an exact-shell renderer, see docs/DECISIONS/0003

src/_data/migratedContent.js.purpose: Generic Eleventy data loader — reads every content/{track}/ with a _meta.json into migratedContent.{trackId}, sorted per chapterOrder. Any future migrated track needs zero code change to show up here

src/dev-content-preview/.purpose: PERMANENT dev utility, not linked from nav — loops over every track in migratedContent and renders it through the real partials, for checking a track's content/schema before its own page cutover. Not a production page

src/_includes/partials/subject-head.njk.purpose: Renders a track's page <h1> + stat row from courseMeta.pageHeader

src/_includes/partials/rail.njk.purpose: Renders the chapter nav sidebar — wires the site's EXISTING goChapter() JS, unmodified. Order must match chapterOrder exactly (showView() defaults to the first DOM .chapter if none is active)

src/_includes/partials/test-generator.nj.purpose: Renders a track's randomized-test-builder section from courseMeta.testGenerator — bank-data-driven JS (genTest/genFullExam), unmodified

bank-data/.purpose: Per-track MCQ question pools (21 files), fetched client-side at runtime - already the target pattern, do not restructure

courses/.purpose: Currently unused (.gitkeep only) - distinct from content/, do not assume interchangeable

public/css/main.css.purpose: Design tokens (87 CSS custom properties) + component styles, extracted by build.js for legacy tracks. See docs/DESIGN_TOKENS.md

public/js/engine.js.purpose: Extracted inline JS from index.html - quiz generation, explorer canvases, UI logic

public/js/cloud-sync.js.purpose: Supabase-backed localStorage mirror for cross-device progress sync

public/downloads/.purpose: 1,880 worksheet/answer-key PDFs, one pair per topic per track - content asset, exclude from AI context reads

supabase/schema.sql.purpose: DB schema + RLS policies for the cloud-sync feature

tools/worksheet_gen/.purpose: Standalone PDF worksheet generator, not wired into the build/CI graph

docs/PHASE1-2_TARGET_ARCHITECTURE.md.purpose: Active migration plan - principles, target architecture, work-package sequence

docs/RECIPES.md.purpose: Exact file-level steps for the 10 benchmark maintenance tasks

docs/CONTENT_MODEL.md.purpose: content/{track}/*.json shape, the bilingual field rule, worked example

docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.purpose: System design: the two content systems, data flow, explorer-engine boundary, chapter-switching mechanism

docs/DEPLOY.md.purpose: Build, environments, CI/CD, deploy workflow, rollback (incl. the migrated-track rollback path)

docs/PHASE8_TOKEN_VERIFICATION.md.purpose: Real measured token-cost reduction for the 10 benchmark tasks, qudrat scope only — honest about what is and isn't proven site-wide yet

docs/DECISIONS/.purpose: One short ADR per significant architecture decision

scripts/sweep-hex-to-tokens.py.purpose: Finds/replaces hardcoded hex colors in index.html's <style> blocks that exactly duplicate a design token (WP2)

scripts/check-shell-sync.js.purpose: Build-time check: fails if index.html's header/footer drifts from build.js's baseNjk header/footer (WP3). Run via npm run build or npm run check-shell-sync

scripts/validate-content.js.purpose: Build-time check: validates content/{track}/*.json against course_schema.json via ajv (WP5). Run via npm run build or npm run validate-content

AUDIT.md.purpose: Pre-Eleventy-migration Phase 0 audit (2026-07-02) - historical record, largely superseded by docs/INVENTORY.md

DEDUP_LOG.md.purpose: Log of duplicate content blocks removed during migration - currently empty (0 removed)

MATH_ERRATA.md.purpose: Log of mathematical errors found during review - currently empty (0 found)

SUPABASE_SETUP.md.purpose: Setup guide for the optional cloud-sync/accounts feature
